shot.framing: vertical, sunlit sand in the lower half

subject.character: big scorpion behind a stone slab, contract under one claw, mic at his mouth
subject.physicality: armoured and unhurried, tail up, tip twitching
subject.signature_action: signs the contract with a flourish, dipping the sting like a pen
subject.consistency: same scorpion, same slab; the beetle is the only other animal

cast.beetle: dung beetle in a cap, on the slab by the lens from 0.6 s, restless

props.contract: one contract: opened, signed, handed over, unrolls down the dune, then lies on the sand
props.coin: one coin lent, two brought back, a third under the beetle's cap

environment: open desert at midday, pale dunes, a sun-bleached stone slab
lighting: hard midday sun, sand and stone the brightest surfaces, short black shadow under him
voice: male, low warm chest voice around 130 Hz, dry and unhurried
lip_sync: a clearly visible mouth opens and closes on every syllable, jaw and lips shaping the words; the voice comes from the animal, never a voice over

audio.pronunciation: «Без отказа» = bez-at-ka-ZA, ending on a fully voiced open A
audio.pacing: a clear silent pause after every sentence. Nothing spoken after 4.8

speech_rule: while the scorpion speaks he touches nothing — only his mouth works and the camera moves. Anything moving then is the beetle or the wind. Paper and coins are handled only in silent beats

timeline.a: a claw slams the rolled contract onto the hot stone, sand jumping. Silent
speaking only, calm tempo, every word fully voiced. A beetle in a cap scrambles onto the slab by the lens
timeline.cam: pushes in past the beetle to his face

timeline.a: silent. Wind drags sand over the slab
speaking only, calm tempo, the last vowel fully voiced. The beetle paces at the lens
silent. A bird's shadow crosses the stone
speaking only, calm tempo. The beetle taps the slab impatiently
silent. The loose end of the contract flaps
speaking only. The beetle freezes and looks up
silent from here on. Both claws sweep the contract open over the slab
the sting comes down and signs with a handwritten flourish
the beetle takes the paper and shakes the claw
the scorpion slides one gold coin over the stone; the beetle grabs it
the beetle leaves rolling the coin, the contract unrolls behind him, snaps taut and drags him back
the beetle sets two gold coins on the stone and spreads his legs
the sting flicks the beetle's cap up, a third coin drops out, the beetle bolts

negative_prompt: the scorpion touching anything while he speaks, hurried speech, a swallowed final vowel, speech after 4.9 s, a voice over, a mouth that does not move, visible cuts, the beetle speaking, a second scorpion, duplicate props, extra coins, floating objects, dim scene, locked-off camera, snap zoom, printed text on the paper, subtitles, watermark, English speech, foreign accent
